scope: Required-check/history cohort before the cgroup cache estimate correction. All four attempts retained.
root_cause: Cgroup memory.current includes inactive file cache. Download/build cache made available RAM appear below minimum despite reclaimable pages.
change: Subtract inactive file cache from cgroup working-set usage; cap by host MemAvailable; do not count anonymous/tmpfs/active file pages as free.
